source_correction.reason: The original1MiB source prefix omitted later rows in the same daily member.
source_correction.scope: Post-opening completeness correction on the same locked schedule. Strict input cohort and scores remain unchanged; no new independent confirmation is claimed.

protocol.actuals_status_before_freeze: No actual-label source/score in V5 or first V6 calibration cohort; only old RT archives/date lists existed.

modes.fixed_selector: Max raw frozen catch probability; tie scheduled time then outgoing ID. Only this selector protected.
modes.menu_max: Maximum nonconformity across all outgoing candidates for each incoming state. Protects any first selector within the frozen menu.

protocol.service_region: Union of CANCELED category and operating clock interval. No cancellation probability calibration is claimed.
protocol.missingness: Unknown clock/service gives score interval[-infinity,+infinity]; calibration factor has identified lower/upper. Use upper for finite coverage; retain vacuous if infinite.
protocol.rank_target: Each group/date contributes ceil(.9*n_incoming)-th state score; date is maximum over present groups; largest of9 calibration dates. Under exchangeable date blocks, >=90% probability that every present group has >=90% incoming states covered next date.
protocol.scope: Counterfactual retained input states, not the adaptively visited journey-state distribution. Both menus scored separately. Input-only selector never reads outgoing truth.
protocol.no_further_selection: Student/shrunk parameters unchanged; only this predetermined selection score is calibrated. No models, groups, dates or factors are chosen using the new three date labels.
